blocks.text: Workers of the construction firm linked to former congressman Zaldy Co had intentionally installed steel sheet piles (SSP) into a road dike project in Naujan, Oriental Mindoro without the presence of Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH)-Mimaropa officials, a witness said on Wednesday.
